title: PT Serif
description: Get the PT Serif font into Minecraft!
body:
# PT Serif for Minecraft

Make the default WWW font the default in Minecraft!


## Features

- Gives a new feel of the GUI
- Makes a new default font
- Better font everywhere in Minecraft.




## Installation

It's easy to install as 5 steps:

- Download the latest release
- Go to the Minecraft folder
  - Mac: `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/`
  - Windows: `%APPDATA%\.minecraft`
  - Linux: `~/.minecraft`
- Open the `resourcepacks` folder
- Drag and drop (or copy) the `.zip` file there
- Unpack the `.zip` file there.
